summary: No more false removal alarms, and managed tenants receive updates again.

fixes.title: No false removal alerts
fixes.text: The nightly read-only check sent removal alerts about runs that could not remove anything. It now only logs the finding; nothing was ever removed.

fixes.title: Managed-tenant pull works again
fixes.text: Managed tenants refused every pull after the previous release. The pull works again, and a stop instruction you configure is still checked strictly.

fixes.title: Approved updates are found again
fixes.text: The update tools reported nothing approved even when a version was. They now read the ring correctly.
